text:
emma: Quick follow-up to the morning postmortem. We need firm owners + minimal timelines for the model-registry cascade and auth provider failover. Proposed agenda for the sync at 2pm PT: owners, short-term mitigations, and a quarterly vendor review cadence.

tarun: I'll own the multi-region auth failover design. Short-term: add passive-config to switch to secondary auth endpoint when latency/error rate exceeds threshold. Deliverable: design doc + staging demo. ETA: 4 business days.

kate: I can take the model-registry refresh path. Action items: ensure refresh token handling tolerates transient auth errors and add a retry-with-backoff for manifest fetches. Also adding a test that simulates token revocation. ETA: 72h.

li: Security will rotate the service account tokens for the vendor integration and add a post-rotation smoke test. Also creating a vault rotation policy so next rotations are automated. ETA: 48h.

pm-jules: From PM: I'll draft the customer-facing incident note and an internal impact timeline. Also want a roadmap item to evaluate alternative auth vendors. ETA: internal draft by EOD.

ops-bot: INCIDENT:INC-2026-45-FOLLOWUP created and linked to postmortem. Reminder scheduled for 72h.

emma: Noting recurring pattern: we've hit three auth-related cascades in the past 8 months. We should add a quarterly vendor reliability review and a monthly auth healthboard. @tarun please include costs for multi-region failover.

li: Security question: can we rotate now or do we need a short freeze window? If rotate immediately, we'll follow up with smoke test GH action.

kate: We need staging KMS/Vault write access to validate token rotation tests. Infra please expedite.

tarun: Sketch of failover gating logic (will formalize in doc):

```
if (auth_error_rate_1m > 5% || auth_latency_95p > 1s) {
  enable_passive_secondary = true;
  if (secondary_health == healthy) route_auth_to_secondary();
  emit_metric('auth_failover_triggered');
}
```

li: For rotation automation I'll add a GH workflow that triggers rotation, runs smoke tests, and reverts if smoke fails. Need a mandatory smoke-test pass before closing the rotation ticket.

kate: For the registry: also adding an in-memory short-lived manifest cache with 5s TTL and a degraded-path that serves cached manifests during auth outages. Prototype snippet: 
```
if (auth_down && cache.stale_ok) return cached_manifest;
else fetch_manifest_with_backoff();
```

pm-jules: Customer ask: can we offer a temporary "high-resilience" toggle that routes reads through warmed caches to reduce error surface while we iterate? Product wants to scope.

emma: Good idea. Let's scope as a config flag per-tenant; engineering estimate please.

tarun: Estimate: 2 engineers for one sprint to implement config + gated rollout and tests. Will add to design doc.

li: Security will publish the rotation runbook and smoke-test checklist in the repo. Also recommending a 30-day post-rotation audit to ensure no latent failures.

ops-bot: Note: last 90d auth incidents: 3, avg MTTR 22m. Logging this to INC-2026-45-followups.

emma: I'll create the action tracker GH issue and assign cards. Expect link in ~1h. Please ping here if you need ETA changes.

kate: Blocking item: staging KMS. Can infra confirm ETA?

ops-bot: TICKET: infra#6799 created for staging KMS access. ETA 48h.

li: Will prioritize the secret rotation and GH action once KMS is available.

pm-jules: I'll add vendor-evaluation to next roadmap sync; want a vendor SLA comparison table (frequency, MTTR, regional coverage).

emma: Summary of immediate owners/ETAs: 
- tarun: multi-region auth passive failover design (4d)
- kate: model-registry refresh + cache degraded path (72h)
- li: token rotation + GH smoke test (48h)
- pm-jules: customer comms + vendor evaluation prep (EOD / next sync)

emma: Thanks everyone. We'll review progress in the follow-up sync and close INC-2026-45 items as they complete.

(End of thread)
